documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Somany Ceramics reported modest sales volume growth of 2% to 3% in Q1 FY27, impacted by production shutdowns in Morbi during April, but achieved strong revenue value growth of 24%. EBITDA margins expanded by 3.6% to 11.6% due to higher capacity utilization reaching 83% and turnaround in joint venture performance. Management remains bullish on future demand and has announced a 9+ million square meter greenfield plant in the South, along with various debottlenecking initiatives to augment capacity. Somany Ceramics reported a strong performance for Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore and EBITDA margin improving to 11.6%. The quarter experienced supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter will be maintained or bettered.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

guidance.claim: Volume growth for the year is expected to be in mid-single digits.
The company guides to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more.
guidance.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

guidance.claim: Management targets very decent single-digit volume growth for the tile business in FY27.
guidance.quote: '27 number, we should be able to get a decent single-digit growth in terms of volume.

guidance.claim: Management targets very healthy double-digit growth for the sanitaryware and adhesive business.
guidance.quote: For the sanitaryware and adhesive business would be in very healthy double digits.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in May and June was pretty decent, and July has also been not bad despite rains in many parts of the country.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, management is extremely bullish of the future outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, we are extremely bullish of the future outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports from Morbi are down due to geopolitical reasons by 50% to 60% from the peak.
demand_outlook.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the industry's growth prospects are supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and February.
demand_outlook.quote: So as far as the quarter is concerned, the domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and Feb on account of increased domestic demand reducing the pressure on -- from reducing the pressure from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: March was an aberration month because of circumstances which played out geopolitically.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

demand_outlook.claim: Tile volume increased for GVT sales by 3%, with a reduction in ceramic and PVT by 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: If you see the tiles volume, we have increased our GVT sales by 3%, and there's been a reduction in the ceramic and PVT by 3% correspondingly.

demand_outlook.claim: Sanitaryware grew by 8% for the entire year, closing at INR320 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Sanitaryware has done fairly well. We've grown by 8% for the entire year, and we have closed the figure at INR320 crores, up from INR296 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South with an outlay of approximately INR220 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months. This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital outlay from now to FY27 end is approximately INR275 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles to cater to the Southern market.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex is expected to be contained within INR70 crores to INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: So everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment to make our assets more value-added or more -- towards more capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter increased by 3.6% to 11.6%.
margins_costs.quote: So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The current gas price increase has been between 16% and 18%.
margins_costs.quote: So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Blended natural gas price for the company comes in at about INR68.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improved significantly by 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% for the entire year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA improved quite significantly, 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% in the entire year.

margins_costs.claim: Brand spend has been about 2% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: As far as our business is concerned, our brand spend has been about 2% for the year.

margins_costs.claim: Average price increase in tiles since March is around 16% to 17%.
margins_costs.quote: So in tiles, since March, when this whole crisis started to now, the average price increase is around 16% to 17% as far as tile is concerned.

orders_capacity.quote: Morbi operations have completely started. They have resumed 100% production on very expensive gas

orders_capacity.claim: The company is taking steps to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in existing lines across Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South.
orders_capacity.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%. So that is largely flat.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization improved to 82% during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Of course, in the quarter, it improved to 82%, but otherwise, it's been largely flat.

orders_capacity.claim: Max plant achieved a breakeven, compared to a loss of INR9 crores in the corresponding quarter last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Max plant did -- there's good news there that we almost did a breakeven at Max plant. Corresponding quarter last year, same quarter of Q4, the loss was about INR9 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days have come down from 17 to 12 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Around 65% to 70% of the INR275 crores capex outlay will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: So all put together, we are at about INR275 crores, and we will be funding about 65%, 70% of this through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital is marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital, we've done fairly well. It's marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Net dealer additions were 200 dealers across India, taking total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.
capital_allocation.quote: The net dealer addition has been very strong this year. We've added net new additions of 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cannot do a share buyback for the next 6 to 8 months due to an embargo from SEBI while consolidating wholly owned subsidiaries.
capital_allocation.quote: Unfortunately, we are consolidating some of our JV -- sorry, our wholly owned subs, and therefore, there is an embargo on -- from SEBI. We can't do a share buyback for the next 6, 8 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices have been extremely volatile with small increases every month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster driven by fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices increased very significantly due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that. I'm sure there'll be a lot of question-answers around that.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a major labor shortage in Morbi currently.
risks_headwinds.quote: The situation currently in Morbi is that whoever has started up is facing a little bit of challenge with labor. There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi.

management_commitments.claim: The new plant in the South will be up and ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: The new plant in the South will be operational by end of quarter 3 or beginning of quarter 4 of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: The company's focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to leverage its strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to improve EBITDA margin from the current base by at least 1.5% or more.
management_commitments.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a very aggressive double-digit target for sanitaryware growth.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
